title: Clear the last three brother_printer test modules over the 250-line cap
objective: Bring test_check_brother_printer.py (275 lines), test_consumables.py (272) and test_consumables_part2.py (273) under the repo-wide 250-line cap, taking python_pkg/brother_printer from fifteen violations to zero.
acceptance_criteria: bash ~/utils/scripts/check_file_length.sh --all lists no file under python_pkg/brother_printer.

The brother_printer suite still reports exactly 402 passing tests -- the same count as at the start of this whole package pass, proving no test was dropped or silently skipped across any of the eight commits.
The package keeps 100% branch coverage of the brother_printer source modules.
test_consumables_part2.py's split removes the need for its second MOD_PD constant: the tests that needed it are exactly the ones that move, so each resulting file has one module under test again.
No assertion is changed and no test is deleted, skipped or weakened; whole classes move verbatim and only the import blocks are adjusted.
No suppression is added and no coverage exclusion is introduced.
out_of_scope: Touching the brother_printer source, which is already under the cap.
Other packages' violations, which are separate commits.
verifier: PYTHONPATH=. python3 -m pytest python_pkg/brother_printer/tests -q (expects exactly 402 passed), plus bash ~/utils/scripts/check_file_length.sh --all showing no brother_printer entry, plus pre-commit run --files on the touched files.
